request.description:
Everything the push dialog needs.

`tax_by_branch` precomputes CSGST vs IGST for every branch against this PO's ship-to state — the branch is the from-state for place of supply, so picking the wrong one produces a valid document with the wrong tax.

`addresses` is read live from B1 (BP addresses are not mirrored locally: one customer here has 142). If SAP is unreachable, `address_lookup_error` is set and the rest still works.

Builds the exact JSON that would be POSTed to /b1s/v2/Orders without sending it. Check VatGroup on the lines — CSGST@5 means the branch and ship-to are in the same state, IGST@5 means they are not.

422 with a readable message if the warehouse does not belong to the branch, the branch is disabled, or a line has no B1 item code.

item.name: 17 · Webhooks (partner → us)
item.description:
Partner-to-us endpoints. Authenticated with the `api-key` header ONLY — no login, no Bearer token. A webhook is a plain HTTP POST; there is no socket or handshake.

The Blinkit request carries the complete POVMS contract payload and full field documentation — it can be handed to Blinkit's team as the integration spec.

item.name: Blinkit — push PO (passes every validation, SAP-ready)

request.description:
End-to-end test payload. Lands as **VALIDATED with zero issues**, which the other Blinkit sample does not — it is built to satisfy every rule:

- `sku_code` values are real BLINKIT mappings (→ FG00310 / FG00233 / FG00322), so E002_SKU_UNRESOLVED cannot fire.
- Quantities are whole cases (36×10, 30×8, 36×5), so E008_CASE_SIZE_MISMATCH cannot fire.
- `basic_price` sits on the contracted price, so W004_PRICE_VARIANCE stays quiet.
- `outlet_id` 12543 has a ship-to mapping → FG_MH, so W003_SHIP_TO_UNMAPPED cannot fire.
- CGST 2.5 = SGST 2.5 with IGST null (Maharashtra → Maharashtra), so the tax rules pass.
- `total_amount` equals the sum of the line totals to the paisa, so W006_TOTAL_MISMATCH cannot fire. Each line's taxable value is a multiple of 0.40, which makes 2.5% land exactly on two decimals — otherwise our per-line tax and B1's total-level tax differ by a paisa.

Change `po_number` before re-sending: the same number is de-duplicated rather than creating a second PO.

Then push it: **Purchase Orders → Push to SAP with branch + warehouse** (bpl_id 5, whs_code FG_MH). Verified live → Sales Order 3000046 / DocEntry 1771.

# Blinkit → Let's Try Foods · Purchase Order Creation

Push a PO to us. Implements Blinkit's **POVMS - Purchase Order Creation API Contracts**
(v 2026-02-10). Section numbers below (3.6.x) refer to that document.

The body on this request is a **complete, working example** — every field in the contract
is present and the figures reconcile, so it can be sent as-is to verify connectivity.

---

## Endpoint

```
POST {{baseUrl}}/api/webhooks/BLINKIT
Content-Type: application/json
api-key: <the key we share with you separately>
```

The partner code in the path must be exactly `BLINKIT`, uppercase.
A **webhook is a plain POST** — there is no socket or handshake.

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Accepted. The body is the acknowledgement — read `data.po_status` |
| `401` | `api-key` header missing or does not match |
| `404` | Partner code in the URL is wrong |
| `422` | Payload shape invalid — `details[]` names the exact field |

---

## Top level

| # | Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `type` | string | **yes** | Enum: `PO_CREATION`, `PO_CANCELLATION` |
| 2 | `po_number` | string | **yes** | Must equal `details.po_number` (3.1) |
| 4 | `tenant` | string | **yes** | Enum: `BLINKIT`, `HYPERPURE` |
| 3 | `details` | object | **yes** | Full PO metadata |

> **`tenant` matters.** `HYPERPURE` is a different legal buyer with its own GSTIN, so it
> maps to a different customer account on our side. Sending the wrong value invoices the
> wrong entity.

## details

| # | Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3.1 | `po_number` | string | **yes** | Must match the top-level value |
| — | `outlet_id` | integer | **yes** | Your DC / outlet identifier |
| — | `issue_date` | string | **yes** | ISO-8601 UTC |
| 3.2 | `expiry_date` | string | no | ISO-8601 UTC |
| 3.3 | `delivery_date` | string | no | ISO-8601 UTC |
| 3.5 | `vehicle_details.license_number` | string | no | Receiving vehicle |
| 3.7 | `total_sku` | integer | **yes** | Must equal `item_data` length |
| 3.8 | `total_qty` | integer | **yes** | Must equal the sum of `units_ordered` |
| 3.9 | `total_amount` | number | **yes** | Must equal the sum of line values |
| 3.10 | `custom_attributes[]` | array | no | Free-form `{name, value}` metadata |

> We compare `total_sku`, `total_qty` and `total_amount` against the lines we parse. A
> mismatch does not reject the PO, but it is flagged for manual review before invoicing
> and will slow the order down.

## details.buyer_details (3.4)

| # | Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3.4.1 | `name` | string | no |
| 3.4.2 | `gstin` | string | **yes** |
| 3.4.3 | `destination_address` | object | **yes** |
| 3.4.5 | `registered_address` | object | **yes** |
| 3.4.6 | `contact_details[]` | array | **yes** — `{name, phone, email}` |

Address objects carry `line1`, `line2`, `city`, `state`, `postal_code`, `country`.
`postal_code` is required (3.4.4.5); the rest are optional.

> **Send `state`.** Indian GST requires CGST+SGST for an intra-state movement and IGST
> for inter-state. We determine which by comparing your delivery state against ours.

## details.supplier_details (3.5)

`id`, `name`, `gstin`, `pan`, `shipping_address`, `registered_address` are required;
`contact_details[]` is optional.

## details.item_data[] (3.6)

| # | Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3.6.1 | `item_id` | integer | **yes** | Your internal item ID |
| 3.6.2 | `sku_code` | string | no | **Optional but strongly preferred** — see below |
| 3.6.3 | `line_number` | integer | **yes** | Zero-based is accepted |
| 3.6.4 | `units_ordered` | integer | **yes** | Must be > 0 |
| 3.6.5 | `landing_price` | number | **yes** | Incl. logistics and taxes |
| 3.6.6 | `basic_price` | number | **yes** | **Pre-tax cost price — we bill on this** |
| 3.6.7 | `tax_details` | object | no | See below |
| 3.6.8 | `name` | string | **yes** | Item name |
| 3.6.9 | `mrp` | number | **yes** | Maximum Retail Price |
| 3.6.10 | `upc` | string | **yes** | GTIN / UPC |
| 3.6.11 | `uom` | object | **yes** | `{unit, value}` — e.g. `{"unit":"g","value":57}` |
| 3.6.12 | `crates_config` | object | no | `{crates_ordered, crate_size}` |

> **`sku_code` — please always send it.** It is the field we map to our item master. It
> is optional in the contract, and when it is empty we fall back to `item_id`, but that
> requires a separate mapping on our side and delays the order. Sending `sku_code`
> avoids the problem entirely.

> **`basic_price` vs `landing_price`.** We compute the taxable value from `basic_price`
> because `landing_price` already includes tax — using it would double-count.

### tax_details (3.6.7)

| # | Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3.6.7.1 | `cgst_percentage` | number | Intra-state |
| 3.6.7.2 | `sgst_percentage` | number | Intra-state |
| 3.6.7.3 | `igst_percentage` | number | Inter-state — `null` when intra-state |
| 3.6.7.4 | `cess_percentage` | number | A **percentage** |
| 3.6.7.5 | `additional_cess_value` | number | A **flat amount**, not a percentage |

CGST+SGST and IGST are mutually exclusive. Send `null` for the ones that do not apply —
the example uses CGST+SGST with `igst_percentage: null`.

## Response

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "PO received",
  "timestamp": "2026-08-19T13:07:06Z",
  "data": {
    "po_status": "processing",
    "po_number": "2264110001440",
    "errors": [],
    "warnings": []
  }
}
```

`data.po_status` enum: `processing` · `accepted` · `partially_accepted` · `rejected`.

We return `processing` immediately — the PO is stored and queued. The final outcome
follows on the acknowledgement flow.

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `E101` | Duplicate PO number |
| `E102` | Outlet not found |
| `E103` | Supplier GST mismatch |
| `E104` | Buyer GST mismatch |
| `E105` | SKU-level error (MRP missing, qty over max) |
| `W101` | UOM mismatch — created with the default UOM |

**Retries are safe.** We de-duplicate on `po_number`, so re-sending the same PO updates
rather than duplicating it.
